normalization.note: mu_random and sigma_random are normalization statistics; null denotes an unavailable statistic. Required parameter completeness is evaluated by predict_solubility before numeric output.
normalization.protocol: Tartaglia et al. 2008 Eq.4-5: 1) generate N_S random sequences of length N with amino-acid frequencies from SWISS-PROT statistics; 2) compute Eq.2 profile for each; 3) mu_random = mean of profile over all positions of all sequences, sigma_random = std; 4) paper confirms mu and sigma nearly constant for N from 50 to 1000 -> use N=200, N_S=100000 (converges)
